thread:
nadia: quick catch — while doing a docs sweep I found a stale KV example and a couple of internal links that 404. leaving notes before I open a PR. :wave:

cli-bot: link-scan: /console/playground/kv-patterns -> 404, /docs/examples/tracehook-old-js -> 404. flagged medium.

nadia: the playground page still shows this Python snippet:

```
# python
from redwood import ConsoleClient
c = ConsoleClient()
c.prefetch('user:42', max_prefix=1024)
```

nadia: new SDK removed `prefetch`. current replacement in SDK is `kv_fetch_many` which returns a list of items with per-item latency. example should be:

```
# python
items = c.kv_fetch_many('user:42', max_items=8)
# items -> [{"key": "user:42:1", "value": "...", "latency_ms": 3}, ...]
```

jules::+1: on updating. note the cost/latency example uses `sum(latencies.values())` so that needs either a compat shim or rewrite.

tom: propose a tiny compat snippet to show how to reshape list -> dict so teams can migrate incrementally:

```
# compat shim
lat_map = {it['key']: it['latency_ms'] for it in items}
cost_ms = sum(lat_map.values())
```

ivy: also add a short migration note under the SDK section: "prefetch -> kv_fetch_many (return shape changed)." and add frontmatter redirect for the removed page so external links don't break. frontmatter example:

---
redirect_from:
  - /console/playground/kv-patterns
---

docsmith: when you open the PR please include a tiny 300x120 PNG of a trace span showing the new `key` attribute for QA, and add a docs-ci smoke check step to assert no 404s.

nadia: will do. I'll open PR after lunch, include updated snippet, compat shim, redirect frontmatter, trace PNG, and a one-line changelog. PR link will be posted here once created. thanks all! :thumbsup:
